layout_principles: Bold headline text overlay at top or center
High-contrast text on semi-transparent dark scrim or white panel
Professional photography of real service scenario
Brand color accent (blue, orange, or green depending on niche)
CTA button at bottom (Get Free Quote / Book Now / Call Today)
Trust badge or star rating visible
design_system.negative_prompts: cartoon, illustration, watermark, blurry, low quality, text errors, distorted faces, amateur photography, cluttered layout, small text, illegible text
